prompt:
A line-art multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 3 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 8 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a colouring-book drawing: contours only, in one thin uniform black line on white, most of the panel left white. Draw only the people and the few large shapes of the place (walls, doors, windows, a bed, a car). People are simple storyboard figures: hair is one smooth outline of its shape, like a cap, empty inside, with no strands, curls or waves; a face has one short line each for the eyes, brows, nose and mouth, and no stubble, wrinkles or jaw lines; a fence is its posts and top rail, a tree its outline. No texture, mesh, bricks, leaves or fabric folds; no shading, grey or solid black: dark hair, clothes and cars are outlines left white inside. Thin black panel borders, plain white gutters. Location: SU YAQING'S DINING AREA, Day, soft daylight through the tall window.
Image 1: the character sheet of 林青羽 (21), look S0
Image 2: the location SU YAQING'S DINING AREA, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 3: the location SU YAQING'S DINING AREA, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 4: the location SU YAQING'S DINING AREA, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 5: the location SU YAQING'S DINING AREA, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 6: the location SU YAQING'S DINING AREA, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 7: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 8: the prop call phone; use only structure, material, and color
Draw each character so they can be told apart as in their reference image, by the shape of the hairstyle, the build and the outfit in outline only; never copy the photograph's detail. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the layout of the space and the place of its furniture and props, drawn in outline. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Lin Qingyu sits in the upholstered chair by the tall window at the round white marble table, facing into the room. One vase of daisies and one wine bottle stand in the middle of the table. He holds the black call phone in his hand on the table. The brass pendant lamp hangs above the table. The camera is across the marble table from him, on the room side, and stays on that side.
Panel 1: Wide shot, slow push in from across the marble table, eye-level. Lin Qingyu sits by the tall window behind the daisies and wine bottle. His smile fades as he raises the call phone to his ear.
Panel 2: Medium shot, locked-off camera across the table, eye-level. Lin Qingyu's expression turns serious and commanding, his elbow on the marble table.
Panel 3: Extreme close-up insert, high angle on the table. Lin Qingyu's fingers tap the marble tabletop beside the wine bottle.
Panel 4: Medium close-up, low angle. Lin Qingyu leans forward, the daylight from the window edging his face.
Panel 5: Close-up, slow push in, eye-level. Lin Qingyu's eyes narrow and flick toward the room behind the camera.
Panel 6: Medium shot, high angle over the daisies. Lin Qingyu leans back in the chair with the phone at his ear, his mouth closed, brows lifting impatiently.
Panel 7: Close-up, low angle, locked-off camera. Lin Qingyu cuts in with a confident half smile.
Panel 8: Wide shot, slow pull out from across the marble table, eye-level. Lin Qingyu lowers the phone onto the marble table and turns to look out of the tall window, smiling.
Keep the characters, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no photographic rendering.
